title: WV-CUST-NAME is too small for the widened value
detail: Reached through a sql-fetch edge at examples/redefines/src/wvload.pco:34. Current PIC holds alphanumeric(30), but alphanumeric(50) arrives here. COBOL truncates on the left for numerics and on the right for alphanumerics, without any runtime error.

title: WV-VALUE is too small for the widened value
detail: Reached through a sql-fetch edge at examples/redefines/src/wvload.pco:34. Current PIC holds signed numeric(10.2), but signed numeric(13.2) arrives here. COBOL truncates on the left for numerics and on the right for alphanumerics, without any runtime error.

title: WV-CUTBLA-KEY: record length grows 42 -> 62 bytes
remediation: Rebuild the record layout, then recompile every program that copies this group and reload any file written with the old length.
detail: This group contains a field that must widen, so every file, queue, CALL interface or REDEFINES that assumes the old record length has to be reviewed and rebuilt.
